plan.goal: Generate one compact de novo soluble protein candidate, collect sequence and basic structure-supporting evidence, run lightweight QC, and rank the result.
assumptions: A single small monomeric design is sufficient for this compact exploratory workflow.
Unconditional backbone generation plus inverse folding is acceptable without a target structure or motif.
Sequence-based evidence and lightweight QC are adequate if no exact structure-prediction input JSON is provided.
